name: Success Message Popups for Contact Form 7
author: Azamat

sections.description:
Show a success message popup after a Contact Form 7 submission so visitors know their message was sent. When a submission needs attention, show the corresponding validation, spam or mail failure message. Choose a modal popup for a prominent response or a toast notification for a smaller on-screen message.

Give visitors the right feedback

  • Success: Display a confirmation when Contact Form 7 reports that the message was sent.
  • Validation error: Let visitors know when they need to correct a field and submit again.
  • Spam: Display the response when Contact Form 7 flags a submission as spam.
  • Mail failure: Show the error message when Contact Form 7 cannot send the email.

The plugin uses the response text configured in Contact Form 7, so the message remains part of your form setup instead of being duplicated in another settings screen.

Preview the result before publishing

Choose the popup or toast appearance, adjust its accent color and position, and configure its timing and dismissal controls. Use the interactive settings preview to try success, validation, spam and mail-failure notifications without filling out the form each time. Preview changes before saving them.

Built for real Contact Form 7 pages

  • Supports multiple Contact Form 7 forms on the same page.
  • Handles forms inserted after the page loads, including forms initialized by dynamic content.
  • Uses keyboard-friendly modal dismissal and returns focus to the relevant invalid field after validation dialogs.
  • Respects reduced-motion preferences.
  • Uses responsive, RTL-aware settings and notification layouts.

Lightweight by design

The small event listener does not depend on frontend jQuery. SweetAlert2 is bundled locally and loaded only after a Contact Form 7 form appears on the page. If the popup library cannot load or JavaScript is unavailable, Contact Form 7’s native response remains available as the fallback.

Completely free

All features are included. There are no premium upgrades, subscriptions, advertisements or locked settings.

Previously published as Result Popups for CF7. The plugin slug remains result-popups-for-cf7, so existing installations and saved settings continue to work.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Contact Form 7.
  2. Install Success Message Popups for Contact Form 7 from the WordPress Plugin Directory, or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/result-popups-for-cf7/.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  4. Open Contact → Success Message Popups to choose a popup or toast style and preview the result.
  5. Submit a Contact Form 7 form. Its configured response message will appear using your selected notification style.
sections.faq:
How do I show a popup after a successful Contact Form 7 submission?

Activate Contact Form 7 and this plugin. Successful AJAX submissions are displayed as a popup automatically. Open Contact → Success Message Popups if you want to adjust the appearance or dismissal behavior.

Can I show a toast notification instead of a popup?

Yes. Enable Toast style on the settings screen, choose a position, and save. Toasts use the same Contact Form 7 response messages in a smaller notification.

Which Contact Form 7 error messages can appear in a popup?

The plugin handles Contact Form 7 validation errors, spam responses and mail failures, as well as successful submissions.

Where do I edit the success message text in Contact Form 7?

Edit the form in Contact → Contact Forms, open its Messages tab, and change the message for successful mail delivery. This plugin displays the text supplied by Contact Form 7.

Can I change the popup position, close button and dismissal timing?

Yes. The settings screen includes notification position, confirmation and close buttons, automatic dismissal timing, backdrop, outside-click and Escape-key controls where they apply.

How can I preview a CF7 success or error popup without submitting the form?

Use the Preview notifications panel on the plugin settings screen. It can preview success, validation, spam and mail-failure results using your current unsaved controls.

Does this plugin open the form in a popup, or show a message after submission?

It shows the Contact Form 7 response message after submission. It does not place the form itself inside a popup.

Is this plugin completely free?

Yes. Every setting and notification mode is included with no premium version, subscription or locked feature.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New name: Success Message Popups for Contact Form 7. The plugin slug and saved settings are unchanged.
  • Redesigned settings screen with grouped controls and live previews of success, validation, spam and mail-failure notifications, including unsaved changes.
  • Restore defaults now asks for confirmation and shows a one-time notice.
  • No frontend jQuery; SweetAlert2 loads only when a Contact Form 7 form is on the page.
  • Supports multiple forms on one page and forms added after the page loads.
  • Contact Form 7’s own message remains visible if a popup cannot be shown.
  • Validation dialogs return focus to the first invalid field; reduced-motion preferences are respected.
  • Popups at the top of the screen stay below the WordPress admin toolbar.
  • Toasts with no button and no timer now include a close button.
  • Fix: options that are on by default can now be switched off and saved.
  • Fix: an empty button text no longer creates an unlabeled button.
  • Fix: the settings page appears under the current Contact Form 7 menu.
  • Security: permission and security-token checks on all settings changes; stricter checks on saved values.
  • Updated SweetAlert2 to 11.26.26 and included its license notice.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • SweetAlert2 integration for Contact Form 7 submission results.
  • Optional settings for notification appearance and behavior.
  • Success, validation, spam and mail-failure message support.
